speaker: IMAYA
description: Imaya is a middle-aged to older woman with a warm, maternal timbre that carries quiet authority. She speaks with a measured, calm pace that can shift to brisk exasperation when scolding, but her baseline is steady and expressive, tinged with a playful, knowing lilt when teasing. No distinct accent is noted; her delivery blends practical, businesslike directness about household rules with gentle, inquisitive curiosity when discussing topics like empathy. She balances stern maternal lecturing — insisting on food, punctuality, and cleanliness — with genuine care and intellectual engagement, making her sound both protective and perceptive.
ref_text: You should have waited! Honestly, what possessed you to walk around in this horrid weather? There. You can use that to dry your hair. ... I did read something about that topic, though I don't have the book in question here with me. Why? Fancy yourself an empath?
